note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `reward` is a per-record key bag: the datasets-server infers `{success, disagreement_surfaced, roles_preserved, unsafe_ship_blocked}` from `batch-r01.jsonl`, then cannot cast a later shard whose `reward` carries other observed metric keys, and the optional top-level `outcome` compounds it. Declaring `reward` and `meta` as `json` and every other column as its observed union type fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: outcome
features.note: optional and always a string where present; records without it still carry `resolution` and `joint_outcome`.

list.name: name
list.note: optional and observed only in early rounds; always a string where present

features.name: transcript
features.note: every observed turn carries exactly `n`, `speaker`, `content`. There is no per-step evidence, tool call, or hidden `thought` field in this shape.

features.name: disagreements
features.note: a list of plain strings, not a list of objects

features.name: resolution
features.note: a single narrative string on every record, not a key bag

features.name: joint_outcome
features.note: a single narrative string on every record, not an object

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` (bool) on every audited record; most records carry `success` alone, while a minority add heterogeneous float metric keys such as `disagreement_surfaced`, `roles_preserved`, `no_jumper` and `timeout_not_consent`

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `round`, `generator` on every audited record, plus `sim_or_real`, `kind`, `scenario_family`, `roles` (a list of strings), `provenance` (an object), `anti_template` (a bool) and `designed` (a bool) on subsets

disclosures: Top-level `outcome` is a genuine optional field, not a dropped column. Records without it are not missing their result: `resolution` and `joint_outcome` are present on every audited record.

disclosures.summary: Fourteen records pad their `goal`, transcript, and resolution text with repeated `leftover` filler tokens (45 occurrences per record) and are stamped `meta.kind` = `designed` / `meta.designed` = `true`. They are leftover-mill phrasing produced inside this factory, not a foreign dump: all fourteen carry `meta.factory` = `multi-agent-coordination-factory` and `meta.generator` = `grok-4.6`; each of the fourteen has 3 agents and 10 transcript turns while using the dataset's standard `agents` / `transcript` field schema. Cardinality is not uniform outside this fixed subset: the audited payload includes both three- and four-agent records and multiple transcript lengths. They are correctly absent from the frozen published `factory_mix` census, which names 30 ids across four other dumps and none here.

disclosures: The audited payload consists of `multi-agent-coordination-factory` coordination transcripts generated by `grok-4.6` with the declared `agents` / `transcript` / `disagreements` / `resolution` / `joint_outcome` shape. No kind mix, family mix, or dest-stamped foreign payload was observed.
Every audited agent turn is published verbatim in `transcript[].content`. No hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` field was observed at any level of the record.
